script: In 1869, a farmer's well diggers hit something that should not have existed at all. On his farm in Cardiff, New York, workers unearthed a ten-foot stone man buried just below the surface. It was not ancient. The farmer's own cousin had it carved from an eleven-foot block of gypsum, aged with acid and needle marks, then secretly buried it a year earlier. Thousands paid to see it anyway, believing it proved the Bible's giants were real. The farmer raised the ticket price twice in one week. Scientists called it an obvious fake almost immediately, but the crowds kept coming until the cousin finally confessed two months later. Here's the part almost nobody expects. P.T. Barnum offered fifty thousand dollars for the giant. Turned down, he built his own fake and called it the real one - and his fake of a fake outdrew the original. When the giant's owners sued him for fraud, the judge said they would first have to prove their own giant was real. They dropped the case. A fake fossil beat a real museum in ticket sales, twice. Follow for more history too strange to make up.

metadata.title: Random But True: The Ten-Foot Man That Wasn't Real
metadata.caption:
On October 16, 1869, well diggers on a farm in Cardiff, New York unearthed a ten-foot stone man buried just below the surface.

It wasn't ancient. The farmer's own cousin had it carved from an eleven-foot block of gypsum, aged with acid and needle marks, then secretly buried it a year earlier.

Thousands paid to see it anyway, believing it proved the Bible's giants were real - the farmer raised the ticket price twice in one week. Scientists called it an obvious fake almost immediately, but the crowds kept coming until the cousin confessed two months later.

Here's the part almost nobody expects: P.T. Barnum offered fifty thousand dollars for the giant. Turned down, he simply built his own fake and displayed it as the real one - and his fake of a fake outdrew the original.

When the giant's owners sued Barnum for fraud, the judge said they'd first have to prove their own giant was genuine. They dropped the case.
